shortDescription: Resource module for Wireless Controllers Wireless Mobility Groups Mobility Provision

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: dataLinkEncryption
options.description: A secure link in which data is encrypted using CAPWAP DTLS protocol can be established between two controllers. This value will be applied to all peers during POST operation.

options.name: macAddress
options.description: Device mobility MAC Address. Allowed formats are 0a0b.0c01.0211, 0a0b0c010211, 0a 0b 0c 01 02 11.

options.name: mobilityGroupName
options.description: Self device Group Name. Must be alphanumeric without {!,<,space,?/'} and maximum of 31 characters.

options.name: mobilityPeers
options.description: Wireless Controllers Wireless Mobility Groups Mobility Provision's mobilityPeers.

options.name: networkDeviceId
options.description: Obtain the network device ID value by using the API call GET /dna/intent/api/v1/network-device/ip-...

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
